title: Card-Linked Uplift to the Promotional Yield on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
The yield that applies to the promotional basis of an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts is the tier's promotional annual percentage yield, raised for owners who use their Piedmont Crescent Bank credit card. The card purchases counted are those posted on the owner's card under Personal Credit Cards in the three calendar months ending on the correction date, and the second condition is the size of the promotional basis itself.

| Card purchases posted in the three calendar months ending on the correction date | Promotional basis | Yield that applies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 or more | at least 800.00 USD | the tier's promotional annual percentage yield raised by 0.60 percentage points |
| 2 or 3 | at least 800.00 USD | the tier's promotional annual percentage yield raised by 0.25 percentage points |
| fewer than 2 | any | the tier's promotional annual percentage yield unchanged |
| any | below 800.00 USD | the tier's promotional annual percentage yield unchanged |

### How the two conditions work together

Both conditions must hold for an uplift. Where 4 or more card purchases posted in the window and the promotional basis reaches 800.00 USD, the uplift is 0.60 percentage points. Where the count falls to 2 or 3 and the promotional basis still reaches 800.00 USD, the uplift is 0.25 percentage points. Where the count falls below 2, or the promotional basis is below 800.00 USD, no uplift is made at all and the tier's promotional annual percentage yield applies as it stands.

### Boundary figures

A promotional basis of exactly 800.00 USD satisfies the basis condition, which is stated as at least; 799.99 USD does not. A count of exactly 4 card purchases falls in the first band, a count of exactly 2 falls in the second, and a count of 1 or 0 falls outside both.

Take a hypothetical account whose promotional basis is 1200.00 USD and whose owner's Piedmont Crescent Bank credit card shows 3 purchases posted in the window. The count of 3 sits in the band of 2 or 3, and 1200.00 USD reaches 800.00 USD, so the uplift is 0.25 percentage points. Had only 1 purchase posted, no uplift would be made.
